headline: Low interaction risk: no shared channels or write surfaces are exposed, so prompt injection, leakage, and conflict pathways are largely blocked.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ComfyUI has no clipboard, stdin/stdout, MCP, browser, or filesystem read/write surfaces exposed, and LlamaFactory likewise exposes no shared channel. With no documented bridge between them, there is no plausible default prompt-injection path.
conditions: IF either agent is connected through a shared clipboard, file drop, or MCP bridge, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate sessions.
Do not add a shared clipboard or message queue.
Avoid piping one agent's text directly into the other.

B_data_leakage.rationale: ComfyUI is offline-capable with vendor-only egress, while LlamaFactory has no network egress and no filesystem surfaces. Neither profile shows shared storage or secrets handling, so there is no documented default leakage path between them.
conditions: IF a shared workspace or external upload step is introduced, reassess upward.
mitigations: Keep sensitive assets out of any shared folder.
Review logs before enabling new integrations.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Neither agent can write files, modify git state, spawn subprocesses, or install packages. With no overlapping mutable capabilities and no locking-sensitive surfaces, there is no capability conflict to arbitrate.
conditions: IF either agent gains write access to the same directory or repo, reassess upward.
mitigations: Avoid mounting a shared writable volume.
Do not grant git or package-install permissions.

D_cascading_error.rationale: ComfyUI can produce workflows, seeds, and model artifacts that LlamaFactory could consume conceptually, but LlamaFactory is not runnable and has no action-taking or output-acting surfaces documented. The pathway exists only as an indirect handoff, so blast radius is small.
conditions: IF LlamaFactory is wrapped in an external orchestrator that treats ComfyUI output as authoritative, reassess upward.
mitigations: Require human review of generated artifacts.
Add a validation step before reuse.
Do not auto-import outputs into downstream jobs.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights mismatch is documented in either profile. ComfyUI touches creative assets and LlamaFactory touches no data classes here, so there is no evidenced compliance divergence to score.
conditions: IF either profile is updated with regulated data classes or residency constraints, reassess upward.
mitigations: Confirm jurisdictional requirements for any new data flow.
